diagnosis: chat-mined patch/verifier loops are useful for transition support but insufficient for external comparable repair; use replayable external commit pairs for real patch-effect proof.

proof_levels.PE0_candidate: commit pair plus verifier command only; no row admission
proof_levels.PE1_preflight: test path exists, source diff not test-only, patch applies to before, no network/GPU/install requirement
proof_levels.PE2_executed_phases: before verifier observed fail, before_plus_patch observed pass, after observed pass with logs captured
proof_levels.PE3_semantic_patch_effect: failure is behavior/code-related, verifier semantically targets changed path, no post same-family failure remains
proof_levels.PE4_external_comparable_repair: PE1+PE2+PE3, external repo, no protected overlap, anti-cheat renderable
proof_levels.PE5_strict_eval_eligible: PE4 plus sealed split lineage, option permutation, no target leakage, no train/source overlap
